name: Dryad_search_datasets
description: Search the Dryad open research data repository for published datasets using its real `/api/v2/search?q=` endpoint. Returns relevance-ranked dataset metadata with exact total, HAL continuation links, and one-based page metadata. Use Dryad_get_dataset for full metadata.

q.description: Search query string for dataset title, abstract, or author (e.g., 'climate change', 'CRISPR gene editing', 'protein structure')

per_page.description: Number of results per page (default 10, max 100)

oneOf.description: Dryad search results with pagination links and embedded dataset list

_links.description: HAL pagination links (self, first, last, next)

count.description: Number of datasets returned on this page

_embedded.description: Contains stash:datasets array with the dataset records

authors.description: List of dataset authors with names, affiliations, and ORCID IDs

affiliationROR.description: ROR id of the author's affiliation as a URL, e.g. 'https://ror.org/032xfst36'. Present on all 24 author rows measured. The flat copy of affiliations[0].identifier; an author with two affiliations only shows the first here.

affiliations.description: The author's affiliations, each {organization, identifier} with the identifier being a ROR URL. This is the complete list -- affiliationROR carries only the first.

email.description: Author email address as submitted, e.g. 'name@example.org'. Present on 22 of 24 author rows.

order.description: The author's position in the author list, e.g. 2. Present on only 9 of 24 rows, so do NOT sort on it: the rows arrive in author order already and sorting by a mostly-missing key scrambles them.

relatedPublicationISSN.description: ISSN of the related publication journal

_links.description: HAL links including stash:versions and stash:version (contains version ID for file listing)

curationStatus.description: Where the submission stands in Dryad's curation workflow, e.g. 'Published'. A dataset not yet 'Published' may still change.

fieldOfScience.description: Dryad's broad subject class, e.g. 'Biological sciences'. Present on 4 of 5.

funders.description: Funders of the work, each {organization, identifier, awardNumber} as supplied. Up to 5 entries on the measured records.

hsiStatement.description: Human Subjects Information statement: how consent and ethics were handled for data about people. Present on 1 of 5; its presence is the signal that the dataset involves human subjects.

keywords.description: Submitter-supplied keywords, e.g. ['alpine flora', ...] (3 to 13 entries). Present on 3 of the 5 searched datasets -- free text, not a controlled vocabulary.

lastModificationDate.description: Date the record last changed, 'YYYY-MM-DD', e.g. '2023-12-14'. Later than publicationDate whenever a new version exists.

license.description: SPDX licence URL for the dataset, e.g. 'https://spdx.org/licenses/CC0-1.0.html'. Dryad's default is CC0, but this is the field that says so for THIS dataset.

methods.description: The methods section as submitted, in HTML with entity escapes -- not plain text. Present on 2 of 5.

metrics.description: Usage counts for the dataset: {views, downloads, citations}.

publicationDate.description: Date the dataset was first published, 'YYYY-MM-DD', e.g. '2021-06-15'.

relatedWorks.description: Linked outputs, each {relationship, identifierType, identifier}. The entry with relationship 'primary_article' is the paper the dataset belongs to -- usually the thing a reader actually wants.

sharingLink.description: Human-readable Dryad page for the dataset, e.g. 'http://datadryad.org/dataset/doi:10.5061/dryad.7rh4625'.

versionChanges.description: What changed in this version, e.g. 'files_changed' or 'metadata_changed'. 'metadata_changed' means the data files are identical to the previous version.

versionNumber.description: Which version of the dataset this record describes, e.g. 4. Dryad DOIs resolve to the latest version, so a citation without this number is ambiguous.

versionStatus.description: Status of this particular version, e.g. 'submitted'.

visibility.description: Whether the record is visible, e.g. 'public'.

name: Dryad_get_dataset
description: Get detailed metadata for a specific Dryad dataset by its numeric ID. Returns comprehensive information including the DOI identifier, title, authors with affiliations and ORCID IDs, abstract, storage size, related publication ISSN, and HAL links to versions and files. The version ID from the _links.stash:version href can be used with Dryad_get_dataset_files to list downloadable files. Use Dryad_search_datasets first to find dataset IDs.

dataset_id.description: Numeric dataset ID from Dryad (e.g., 93, 94, 95). Find IDs using Dryad_search_datasets.

authors.description: Authors with names, affiliations, ORCID IDs, and ROR affiliations

affiliations.description: The author's affiliations, each {organization, identifier} with the identifier being a ROR URL. This is the complete list -- affiliationROR carries only the first.

_links.description: HAL links including stash:versions and stash:version (contains version ID for file listing)

changedFields.description: The metadata field names this version altered, e.g. ['title', 'abstract', ...] (8 entries on the measured record).

curationStatus.description: Where the submission stands in Dryad's curation workflow, e.g. 'Published'. A dataset not yet 'Published' may still change.

funders.description: Funders of the work, each {organization, identifier, awardNumber} as supplied. Up to 5 entries on the measured records.

keywords.description: Submitter-supplied keywords, e.g. ['alpine flora', ...] (3 to 13 entries). Present on 3 of the 5 searched datasets -- free text, not a controlled vocabulary.

lastModificationDate.description: Date the record last changed, 'YYYY-MM-DD', e.g. '2023-12-14'. Later than publicationDate whenever a new version exists.

license.description: SPDX licence URL for the dataset, e.g. 'https://spdx.org/licenses/CC0-1.0.html'. Dryad's default is CC0, but this is the field that says so for THIS dataset.

locations.description: Geographic coverage, each entry {place} and optionally coordinates, e.g. {'place': 'Africa'}.

metrics.description: Usage counts for the dataset: {views, downloads, citations}.

publicationDate.description: Date the dataset was first published, 'YYYY-MM-DD', e.g. '2021-06-15'.

relatedWorks.description: Linked outputs, each {relationship, identifierType, identifier}. The entry with relationship 'primary_article' is the paper the dataset belongs to -- usually the thing a reader actually wants.

sharingLink.description: Human-readable Dryad page for the dataset, e.g. 'http://datadryad.org/dataset/doi:10.5061/dryad.7rh4625'.

versionChanges.description: What changed in this version, e.g. 'files_changed' or 'metadata_changed'. 'metadata_changed' means the data files are identical to the previous version.

versionNumber.description: Which version of the dataset this record describes, e.g. 4. Dryad DOIs resolve to the latest version, so a citation without this number is ambiguous.

versionStatus.description: Status of this particular version, e.g. 'submitted'.

visibility.description: Whether the record is visible, e.g. 'public'.

name: Dryad_get_dataset_files
description: Get one page of downloadable files for a specific Dryad dataset version. Returns file names, sizes, MIME types, checksums, the exact file total, and HAL continuation metadata. Follow metadata.next_page while metadata.has_more is true; a version may contain more files than the default page. The version_id can be found in Dryad_get_dataset under _links.stash:version.href.

version_id.description: Version ID from Dryad dataset metadata. Found in _links.stash:version.href of Dryad_get_dataset response (e.g., 124910, 94, 93).

per_page.description: Number of files per page (1-100). Defaults to Dryad's native page size of 20.

page.description: One-based file-list page. Dryad silently treats page 0 as page 1, so the wrapper rejects values below 1.

oneOf.description: File listing for the specified dataset version

count.description: Number of files returned on this page

total.description: Total number of files in this version

_embedded.description: Contains stash:files array with file records

_links.description: HAL links including stash:versions and stash:version (contains version ID for file listing)

description.description: The submitter's description of the file, e.g. 'FEA model'. Present on 10 of the 20 files measured -- often the only clue to what a file contains, since Dryad filenames are free-form.
